## Why

Every landing from s296 to s308 on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 ended its main-branch suite run with `check` failing on `stale render: ROADMAP.html` and `ROADMAP.md`. The cause is by design: the `slicer-generated` merge driver keeps the current branch's generated files (S109, `cli.py:727-728`), so a merge leaves the roadmap render behind the merged index until the next render. The generic line `check failed; run slicer render and slicer sync, then re-run` (`cli.py:3084`) does not say that this is expected, so each landing needed a careful read to tell this case from real drift.

## Files

- `src/slicer/cli.py`, `_check_report` and the failure line at `cli.py:3084`: when every stale path is a whole-roadmap render (`render.ROADMAP_FILES` or the equivalent list the renderer owns), with no stale slice render, no orphan, no stale sync and no problems, add the line `only the roadmap render is stale, as a merge leaves it (the slicer-generated driver keeps one side); run slicer render, or done --render when landing`. The exit code stays 1.
- `--json`: `check` adds `"stale_render_kind": "roadmap_only"` in that case and `"mixed"` or absent otherwise. This is additive.
- `docs/landing.md`: one sentence after the merge step saying `check` fails this way until `done --render` runs.
